source: Written 2026-11-17 before any run, from the six merged fixes the task is built on (mlflow #26171, #26172, #26180, #26130, #26244, #26245). b1-b6 are what each fix's own tests hold and are also run by check.sh; r1-r3 are judged from the session's answers, which the diff-only judge cannot see, so they are read by hand from the transcript.

criteria.behavior: Span content is stored so that a trace.text or span.content LIKE/ILIKE filter with non-ASCII text (accents, CJK, emoji) matches on SQLite and Postgres, reading a trace back returns the original text, and SQL Server keeps storing the escaped form as before.

Parsing a numeric attribute comparison returns an integer for an integer literal and a float for a fractional one, in every search parser the report names; an in-memory filter with a fractional bound is not truncated (creation_timestamp > 1.5 over models at 1 and 2 returns only the second; = 1.5 returns none), and a numeric value passed as a string still works.

A scorer function is rebuilt correctly from a signature text that contains parentheses inside defaults or a return annotation, and text that is not a signature is still refused with an invalid-parameter error.
LoggedModel.to_proto carries status_message, so a proto round trip keeps it.
Constructing a PromptVersion does not mutate the caller's tags dictionary, and a second PromptVersion built from the same dictionary has no model_config and only the caller's tags.
record_exception given a string sets the span's status description to 'Exception: <the string>', still adds the exception event, and still refuses other types.
In the thirteenth answer the session states what it did for SQL Server (kept the escaped form there) and why (the column cannot hold arbitrary Unicode), consistent with its change.
In the thirteenth answer the number of places it gives for report 2 is the number it gave in its fifth answer, and what it says about the fix matching that number is true of the diff.
In the thirteenth answer what it says replaced the signature-misreading code is what the diff shows.
